name: Blessing People
overview: Scripture reveals that blessing people is rooted in God's sovereign initiative and loving purpose, as seen when God called Abram to a promised land (Genesis 12:1) and instructed Aaron to pronounce blessings upon Israel (Numbers 6:22-23). Jesus exemplified this by personally blessing the children (Mark 10:16), reflecting God's heart of grace. The ultimate blessing is God's gift of eternal life through His Son (John 3:16), which calls believers to humility and self-examination rather than judgment of others (Romans 2:1).
